summary_en: 440,000 shares (4.85% S/O) to be acquired via open-market purchase on TSE. Upper limit ¥100.2M. Execution window 1 August to 31 December 2026. Stated purpose: shareholder returns and capital-efficiency improvement.
title_en: Notice of Decision on Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On 24 June 2026, Nihonwasou Holdings' board resolved to acquire up to 440,000 treasury shares (4.85% of shares outstanding excluding treasury as of 31 March 2026) for a maximum outlay of ¥100.2 million. The acquisition will be executed via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 1 August and 31 December 2026. The stated purpose is to improve shareholder returns and capital efficiency as part of the company's capital-allocation policy. The company notes that, depending on market conditions, acquisition may be partial or suspended entirely. As of 31 March 2026, shares outstanding (excluding treasury) were 9,134,000; 68,400 treasury shares were to be cancelled effective 30 June 2026.
